contexts.text: Under Bramble, see these references. AC 2831:9. AE 357:18. AE 644:9.
The thorn and the brier () = falsities and evils thence derived. AE 304:11. AE 304:12. AE 730:6.
A pricking brier () = the falsity of the concupiscences of self-love; a thorn = the falsity of the concupiscences of the love of the world.
